correctness.rationale: For every integer m>=2 and alpha,beta>0 real, sum local Bezout multiplicities over the 3m Fermat lines and three coordinate sides to obtain 3A+mB<=3md, 2B<=3d, then bound alpha A+beta B in all weight regimes; explicit lines attain the exact maximum. A local degree-m leading-form calculation removes all base points of the 2m-degree pencil after one blow-up at each of m²+3 points. Grid exceptional sections imply connected generic fibers, and generic smoothness and adjunction establish geometrical integrality and genus. Exact finite checker verifies combinatorics for 2<=m<=40, not the infinite theorem.

originality.rationale: The newly stated invariant is a two-parameter sharp local-positivity function on the full Fermat–Ceva singular-point configuration; known equal-weight calculations are subsumed, not claimed as new. A distinct high-weight chamber is controlled by coordinate sides, and one isotropic, volume-saturating wall is characterized exactly. The general multinet/Ceva pencil itself has classical antecedents and is not offered as an independent discovery. Scholarly and semantic comparisons found no statement implying the entire weighted formula, with a residual risk of unindexed equivalent work.
residual_risks: An older unindexed weighted nef-cone or Zariski-decomposition computation may imply the full two-weight formula.
The m=2 pencil occurs explicitly in classical multinet literature; no priority is claimed for discovering that pencil or for the unweighted Seshadri slice.
The exact constant is established for two uniform strata over the complex numbers, not for arbitrary weights or arbitrary positive-characteristic arrangements.

value.rationale: There are two geometrically distinguished strata with competing local constraints, so the two-weight problem is intrinsic and not an arbitrary numerical slice. The complete chamber formula and extremal-curve exchange, uniqueness of volume equality, and fiber-genus structure supply natural local positivity information for an unbounded sequence of blow-ups and provide a concrete nef isotropic boundary. The uniform-weight value and classical existence of Ceva pencils are explicitly credited as prior coverage.
